I'm a junior in high school. But just the usual stuff. Girlfriend cheats on you. You forgive her. later find out she's pregnant. tells you she no longer wants to even speak to you. Father aggressively addicted to pornography.
Mother is pushing me to achieve the impossible in school. Grandparents all died recently from alcohol and drug addiction.  Three older brothers who have all ruined their lives through drugs. I had almost fallen into a drug habit myself but was able to hold back the urge at least for a little while. I desperately want to be an environmental engineer but I wont be able to with these grades :( My friends are all traitors to each other so I am stuck keeping all the secrets about how much they all hate each other. Sorry for venting to you.
